perspective:
Angela’s available information/perspective:

- She knows Kevin is her close friend since high school, and they have a deep bond where they confide about personal and professional matters. She knows he works in construction and had noticed he seemed unhappy with his job.
- Coffee conversation: Angela invited Kevin. She heard Kevin say he’s been “alright,” just dealing with the usual grind; he is not happy, feels stuck and unfulfilled, and is just going through the motions. He said he has thought about change but doesn’t know where to start and feels overwhelmed. Angela told him she was worried, asked if everything was okay, suggested a different job/career path, and offered to figure out options together. Kevin agreed and thanked her for her support.
- Career-change support: Angela found job openings and a career counseling service. She told Kevin about them. Kevin said she went “all out,” thanked her, and said he’s interested in something creative, maybe design or architecture. Angela encouraged him to check the resources. Kevin said he would and that her support means a lot. Angela believed he was considering a career change and felt supportive/hopeful.
- Career coach: Angela believed Kevin was hesitant and felt frustrated/worried. She arranged a meeting with a career coach and told Kevin. Kevin said she didn’t have to, appreciated it, but wasn’t sure he was ready. Angela encouraged him to take the push. Kevin agreed to give it a shot. He thanked her and said he didn’t know what he’d do without her.
- Progress check-in: Angela asked Kevin how things were going with the career coach. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident about the change. Angela said she was proud and offered more help. Kevin said just knowing she was there was enough, but he’d let her know if he needed anything. Angela promised to always be there. She believed he was making progress and felt proud/relieved.
- Celebration: Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career and felt happy/satisfied. She organized a small celebration party and told him. Kevin thanked her, said it meant a lot, was grateful for her support, and said he couldn’t have done it without her. Angela said he worked hard and came far, and that he did the hard work while she was glad to support him. They celebrated together.
